name: Fontainebleau Las Vegas

address.street: 2777 Las Vegas Blvd S Las Vegas

insider_take: The Strip's newest crown jewel rises 67 stories into the desert sky, bringing French luxury to Sin City with breathtaking views of the entire Las Vegas Valley.
whats_special: This towering resort marks Fontainebleau's first West Coast location, featuring over 3,600 rooms and suites across its iconic curved facade. The property boasts 14 distinct dining venues, including concepts from world-renowned chefs, plus a massive 173,000-square-foot casino floor with the latest gaming technology.
pro_tip: Book a north-facing room above the 40th floor for unobstructed views of the iconic Las Vegas Strip stretching toward downtown – it's especially spectacular at sunset when the neon begins to glow.
dont_miss: The rooftop pool deck offers 360-degree panoramic views of Las Vegas, while the spa features a unique hammam experience. The resort's prime location puts you steps from the Las Vegas Convention Center and just minutes from the Strip's legendary attractions.
pros: Newest luxury resort on the Strip with modern amenities
Multiple award-winning restaurants and celebrity chef dining
Prime Strip location with spectacular city views
cons: Premium pricing as newest luxury property
Limited loyalty program benefits as independent luxury brand
